# superscript-and-subscript

```````````````````````````````` example
2^10^ and H~2~O
.
Document scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2" children=0
    ├── Superscript scope=1:2..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="10" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:6..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" and H" children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:12..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:15..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="O" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^*x*^
.
Document scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Superscript scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Emphasis scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^a b^ ~a b~

P~a\ cat~
.
Document scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^a b^ ~a b~" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Text scope=3:1..3:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="P" children=0
    └── Subscript scope=3:2..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=3:3..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a cat" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^a&#32;b^
.
Document scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Superscript scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:2..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^^ a~~b
.
Document scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Superscript scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=1:3..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a~~b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
~~a~~ ~b~

~~x~ ~~~y~~~
.
Document scope=1:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Strikethrough scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Subscript scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="~~x~ ~~~y~~~" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
text^[note]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="text" children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:5..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:7..1:10 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:5..1:11 id="inline-1" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:7..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
````````````````````````````````


## Composition and fallback

```````````````````````````````` example
^a^b^c^ ~a~b~c~ x^y^z a~b~c
.
Document scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=12
    ├── Superscript scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Superscript scope=1:5..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:8..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:10..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:13..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:14..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:16..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" x" children=0
    ├── Superscript scope=1:18..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="y" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:21..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="z a" children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:24..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:27..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^a	b^ ^a
b^ ~a	b~ ~a
b~
.
Document scope=1:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^a\tb^ ^a" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b^ ~a\tb~ ~a" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=2:12..2:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b~" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^a b^ ^a b^ ~a b~
.
Document scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^a b^ ^a b^ " children=0
    └── Subscript scope=1:16..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=1:17..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^a&#32;b^ ~a&Tab;b~ ^a\ b^ ~a\ b~ a\ b ^a\ b c^
.
Document scope=1:1..1:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=8
    ├── Superscript scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:2..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:10..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:11..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:12..1:18 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a\tb" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:20..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Superscript scope=1:21..1:26 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:22..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:27..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:28..1:33 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:29..1:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:34..1:47 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" a\\ b ^a\\ b c^" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^*a\ b*^ ~[a\ b](u)~ ^[note] ^\[note]^ ^[^1]
.
Document scope=1:1..1:44 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:44 anchor=null attributes={} children=9
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:1..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Emphasis scope=1:2..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:3..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Subscript scope=1:10..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Link scope=1:11..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("u") title=null children=1
│   │       └── Text scope=1:12..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a b" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:21..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Cite scope=1:22..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Citation scope=1:24..1:27 referent=footnote(id="inline-1") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:29..1:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Superscript scope=1:30..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:31..1:37 anchor=null attributes={} literal="[note]" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:39..1:39 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Cite scope=1:40..1:44 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=1:42..1:43 referent=footnote(id="inline-2") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
├── Footnote scope=1:22..1:28 id="inline-1" children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:24..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="note" children=0
└── Footnote scope=1:40..1:44 id="inline-2" children=1
    └── Text scope=1:42..1:43 anchor=null attributes={} literal="^1" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
^~x~^ ~^x^~ ^a~b^c~ ~a^b~c^ ^*x^y*
.

    ├── Text scope=1:6..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:7..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Superscript scope=1:8..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:9..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:12..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
    ├── Superscript scope=1:13..1:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:14..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a~b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:18..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c~ " children=0
    ├── Subscript scope=1:21..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:22..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a^b" children=0
    ├── Text scope=1:26..1:28 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c^ " children=0

    │   └── Text scope=1:30..1:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="*x" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:33..1:34 anchor=null attributes={} literal="y*" children=0
````````````````````````````````

```````````````````````````````` example
| value |
| --- |
| ^a\ b^ ~中~ |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
````````````````````````````````
